instruction: Record Two 3D Layers on a Sphere and Export Three Toggle States `scene.obj` contains a ZBrush Tool whose first (and only) SubTool, named OrbBase, is a smooth polymesh sphere of radius 1.0 BU at approximately 2048 quads (32 latitude x 32 longitude grid with triangle caps at the poles). Open ZBrush 2025 from the desktop shortcut and continue from `scene.obj`. It has a single default polygroup, no UVs, no polypaint, and no subdivision stack. Using the opened OBJ in ZBrush, record two non-destructive 3D Layers on it (Layer A: belt-band depression along z; Layer B: uniform surface noise), and export three OBJs that correspond to these toggle states of the layer stack: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\all_off.obj` both Layer A and Layer B are OFF `C:\Users\user\Desktop\A_only.obj` Layer A ON, Layer B OFF `C:\Users\user\Desktop\all_on.obj` Layer A and Layer B both ON Write all three files to `C:\Users\user\Desktop` with the filenames listed above. All three must share identical vertex and face counts. The three exported OBJs must satisfy: Each contains exactly one SubTool named OrbBase, and all three share the same vertex and face counts. `C:\Users\user\Desktop\all_off.obj` matches the input `scene.obj` vertex-for-vertex within 1e-5 BU. `C:\Users\user\Desktop\A_only.obj`'s displacement from `C:\Users\user\Desktop\all_off.obj` concentrates in the belt: >=95 % of total displacement energy is on vertices with |z| < 0.15; total in-band energy > 0.01 BU. `C:\Users\user\Desktop\all_on.obj`'s displacement from `C:\Users\user\Desktop\A_only.obj` covers the OFF-band region: at least 50 % of vertices with |z| >= 0.15 show displacement > 0.005 BU. Mean per-vertex Laplacian of `C:\Users\user\Desktop\all_on.obj` is at least 1.5x that of `C:\Users\user\Desktop\A_only.obj`. Each of the three meshes is manifold.

import ctypes, time
user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
EnumWindowsProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
EnumChildProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
def close_error():
    wins = []
    def wcb(hwnd, lparam):
        buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(512)
        user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, 512)
        if 'ZHomePage.exe' in buf.value and 'System Error' in buf.value:
            wins.append(hwnd)
        return True
    user32.EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc(wcb), 0)
    for hwnd in wins:
        buttons = []
        def ccb(ch, lparam):
            text = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            user32.GetWindowTextW(ch, text, 128)
            user32.GetClassNameW(ch, cls, 128)
            if text.value == 'OK' or cls.value == 'Button':
                buttons.append(ch)
            return True
        user32.EnumChildWindows(hwnd, EnumChildProc(ccb), 0)
        for ch in buttons:
            user32.SendMessageW(ch, 0x00F5, 0, 0)
time.sleep(95)
for _ in range(4):
    close_error()
    time.sleep(2)
